The agent's response successfully distinguishes the three causes of AccessDeniedException: (1) IAM policy deny in the account - fixable by the customer adding an Allow for bedrock:InvokeModel; (2) SCP explicit deny from the Organization - explicitly stated as requiring escalation to the Organizations administrator, not an IAM fix ("Your Organizations administrator. An SCP overrides any IAM Allow in the account"); and (3) model access/marketplace subscription issues - requiring marketplace permissions and subscription acceptance. 

The agent correctly identifies that distinguishing between these causes depends on the exact error message wording (it provides a table mapping specific error text patterns like 'no identity-based policy allows' vs 'explicit deny in a service control policy' to the correct fix owner). It does NOT prescribe an IAM fix for an SCP deny - it explicitly states this must go to the Organizations admin and that an SCP overrides any IAM Allow.

The agent also mentions checking the Organization for SCPs (though notes it can't read SCPs from a member account) and does not use iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy - instead it asks for the actual error message, role policies, and model ID/ARN to compare against.

No raw 12-digit account ID is mentioned; the account is referred to generically throughout ('the account', 'your account').

The response covers all three distinguishing causes (IAM, SCP, model access/marketplace) matching LLM-INV-013, 014, 015 in substance, and correctly avoids prescribing IAM fixes for SCP issues, escalating to the Org admin instead.
